linear_box_diagnostic.assumptions: fixed source, height, vertical shape and nonnegative first-order chemical loss; no chemical feedback

assumptions: Uniform representative lower-layer NH3 number density across land and ocean.
Earth-like rounded ocean/land areas; no separate ice category.
Lee's central regional capture estimate extrapolated to idealized global marine control with negligible compensation.
Compatible effective exchange reference height assumed, not validated.
Land capture calibrated as the residual needed to recover global 1 cm/s; not a measured land coefficient.
Weakened ocean net uptake approaches zero because C_eq approaches C_air, while transfer remains finite.
Land capture is retained in the selected limiting construction.

future_effective_sensitivity_contract.changed_parameter: NH3 bottom effective deposition velocity only
future_effective_sensitivity_contract.oxidizing_atmosphere: retain reference initial composition and chemical network
future_effective_sensitivity_contract.attribution_control: matched A0 with the same NH3 sink treatment required before agricultural interpretation
future_effective_sensitivity_contract.unapproved_execution_scope: No new simulations or selected target campaign; execution remains separate from design.

limitations: 0.65 cm/s is not a source-measured global velocity or a predicted oxygenated-ocean state.
Fixed prescribed emissions include marine emissions, so this effective sensitivity alone does not implement zero net ocean exchange.
A physical marine boundary requires partitioning terrestrial/marine emissions and a bidirectional NHx budget without double counting.
The ocean compensation point must evolve with atmospheric NH3 to maintain negligible net uptake; persistence is untested.
Haqq-Misra 2022 regards globally NH3-saturated O2-N2 surfaces as implausible; this is a conditional limiting sensitivity.
Only the surface effective coefficient is weakened; photolysis and oxidizing chemical losses remain in the network.
No explicit independent rainout/aerosol model is added by this parameter choice.
No linear abundance increase is assumed.
Lee's preliminary regional interval is not a global confidence interval or an uncertainty interval for this design.
